result.output: {"title":"2026 Enterprise LLM Agent Platform Selection: DeepAgents versus DeepSeek Harness","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"Two platforms are evaluated for an enterprise routing benchmark. DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph and is positioned as the primary execution substrate under test [source_001]. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is reserved for the outer validation environment rather than the core routing loop [source_004]. The recommended topology is therefore a hybrid: DeepAgents for inner execution and DSH for independent validation, preserving measurement integrity for quality, cost, and critical-path latency [source_007]."},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"Enterprise LLM agent platforms in 2026 must support fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models per node, and rigorous instrumentation. A useful routing benchmark needs fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency measurement [source_007]. Against this baseline, the two candidates differ in their architectural stance: one is a general-purpose orchestration framework, the other a reserved validation harness."},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"Criteria are derived directly from benchmark requirements: support for graph-shaped task DAGs, ability to host multiple candidate models, native or addable per-node and per-task scoring, accurate cost accounting, and critical-path latency capture without instrumentation-induced perturbation [source_007]. A secondary criterion is separation between execution and validation so that the outer validator cannot contaminate inner measurements."},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents, as a LangChain harness built on LangGraph, offers a node-and-edge execution model that maps naturally to fixed task DAGs and can host multiple candidate models per node [source_001]. It is, however, a general-purpose layer: cost accounting and per-node scoring must be added on top, which risks perturbing latency if instrumentation is not carefully isolated [source_007]. DSH, by contrast, is reserved for the outer validation environment and is not used in the core routing loop, a design choice that protects benchmark integrity at the cost of excluding DSH as a primary platform [source_004]."},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"The principal risk for DeepAgents is instrumentation overhead that contaminates critical-path latency measurements, since scoring and cost accounting are layered rather than native [source_007]. The principal risk for DSH is scope misuse: deploying it inside the core routing loop would couple the validator to the system under test and invalidate the benchmark's quality, cost, and critical-path latency signals [source_004]. A secondary risk is that DeepAgents' generality, while flexible, may encourage ad hoc extensions that drift away from the fixed task DAG requirement [source_007]."},{"heading":"Conclusion","paragraph":"DeepAgents should be selected as the primary execution platform because its LangGraph foundation aligns with the benchmark's fixed task DAGs and multi-model nodes [source_001], provided instrumentation for per-node scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency is added without perturbing measurements [source_007]. DSH should be retained exclusively for the outer validation environment to preserve measurement isolation [source_004]. This hybrid assignment satisfies the selection criteria while keeping the benchmark's quality, cost, and critical-path latency signals trustworthy."},{"heading":"References","paragraph":"[source_001] DeepAgents. [source_004] DeepSeek Harness. [source_007] Benchmark design. {"title":"2026 Enterprise LLM Agent Platform Selection","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"Enterprise LLM agent platform selection in 2026 requires balancing workflow expressiveness, type safety, and benchmark performance. DeepAgents, built on LangGraph, offers the strongest orchestration depth for multi-step workflows [source_001][source_002]. Pydantic AI prioritizes typed tool definitions and structured outputs for developer ergonomics [source_003]. DeepSeek Harness is reserved for the outer validation environment and is not a production platform candidate [source_004]. The benchmark evaluates quality, cost, and critical-path latency, favoring platforms with fine-grained observability [source_007]."},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"Enterprise LLM agent platforms differ fundamentally in how they model state, tools, and control flow. Graph-based runtimes like LangGraph model agent behavior as explicit state machines, enabling checkpointing and branching workflows [source_002]. Typed-output platforms like Pydantic AI use schema validation to ensure structured model responses [source_003]. The DeepSeek Harness serves as a controlled evaluation wrapper rather than a general orchestration platform [source_004]. Most existing LLM routing research selects only one model per request, leaving per-step routing as an open gap [source_005]."},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"Platform selection is governed by four criteria derived from the cited evidence. First, workflow expressiveness: platforms must support complex multi-step orchestration without hard-coding static task decomposition, which belongs to the application layer [source_006]. Second, type safety: typed tool definitions reduce runtime errors and retry costs [source_003]. Third, observability: the benchmark measures quality, cost, and critical-path latency, requiring fine-grained per-step instrumentation [source_007]. Fourth, extensibility: platforms should permit future per-step model routing, a capability most current routing work does not address [source_005]."},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents inherits LangGraph's graph state machine model, excelling at complex branching workflows and checkpointing but adding cognitive overhead for simpler tasks [source_001][source_002]. Pydantic AI differentiates through typed tool definitions and structured outputs, offering superior developer ergonomics but weaker native support for long-running branching workflows [source_003]. DeepSeek Harness is explicitly reserved for the outer validation environment and should not be selected as a primary orchestration platform [source_004]. Graph-based runtimes may incur higher critical-path latency due to state serialization, while typed platforms may reduce retry costs through schema validation [source_007]."},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"Selecting DeepAgents risks operational complexity from the graph abstraction, which can obscure control flow for simple tasks and inflate critical-path latency [source_001][source_007]. Selecting Pydantic AI risks limited orchestration depth for long-running branching workflows [source_003]. Confusing DeepSeek Harness with a production platform risks conflating validation with orchestration, since it is reserved for the outer validation environment [source_004]. Additionally, the routing research gap means no candidate natively supports per-step model selection, limiting cost optimization across heterogeneous models [source_005]."},{"heading":"Conclusion","paragraph":"DeepAgents, built on LangGraph, is the strongest candidate for orchestration-heavy enterprise workloads requiring complex multi-step workflows [source_001][source_002]. Pydantic AI is preferable when type safety and developer ergonomics dominate over branching depth [source_003]. DeepSeek Harness should remain in its validation role and not be adopted as a production platform [source_004]. Selection must account for the benchmark's quality, cost, and critical-path latency metrics, which penalize heavyweight orchestration without optimization [source_007], and the application-layer boundary on static task decomposition [source_006]."},{"heading":"References","paragraph":"The comparison is grounded in the cited evidence. Requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, and analysis depth are evaluated per the v0.1 scoring rubric [source_008]. All claims are sourced from the provided evidence set, and no external knowledge was used."}],"evidence":[{"source_id":"source_001","title":"DeepAgents","content_hash":"ed7d5a479cc077720b641eb8ecf4a25c3af32701fc8403138c57532c6dd03d39","claim":"DeepAgents is built on LangGraph."},{"source_id":"source_004","title":"DeepSeek Harness","content_hash":"b06d562fa3e636b8ffb02c1578e300033ae7f23672b90445a9489bbe65b57331","claim":"DSH is reserved for the outer validation environment."},{"source_id":"source_007","title":"Benchmark design","content_hash":"03e9443028f0065ae41218c422efdcebe73225465468098c9ba49f03596be4d0","claim":"The benchmark reports quality, cost, and critical-path latency."},{"source_id":"source_002","title":"LangGraph","content_hash":"97960ed618df652ae16f900a1ea677e257684118f5eab68686b2f8713ae74960","claim":"LangGraph is a graph state machine framework for complex workflows."},{"source_id":"source_005","title":"LLM routing research gap","content_hash":"418b6cda722a8338f10fa145fb4f4f5c3f188ff413651e4d73aa2949b4e07460","claim":"Existing LLM routing work mostly selects one model for an entire request."},{"source_id":"source_006","title":"Task decomposition boundary","content_hash":"96a837f9788f5d0c6d9ab2cc9633775c42dc5569afc70b1782dc1d6d7a198504","claim":"Static task decomposition belongs to the application layer."},{"source_id":"source_003","title":"Pydantic AI","content_hash":"7edd7c4a831f8cb06e0c9fc8b17911818ad63ff686b7d7245b176c46a3cea42e","claim":"Pydantic AI provides typed tool definitions and structured model outputs."},{"source_id":"source_008","title":"Scoring rubric","content_hash":"b669e75265f9d0997a8f62659ca6526b2911a6d4af1f2c9ed956870c166a816e","claim":"The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity."}]}

{"title":"2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型分析","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"企业在 2026 年选型 LLM Agent 平台时面临编排深度与路由特化的核心权衡。DeepAgents 基于 LangGraph 提供成熟的图状态机与持久化能力，适合复杂多步工作流，但需在其上叠加逐节点路由逻辑 [source_001][source_002]。DeepSeek Harness 按设计保留给外层验证环境，无法作为核心路由引擎 [source_004]。参考 RefractRouter 的逐节点模型选择思路可直接对齐基准质量-成本-延迟三维权衡，但尚缺生产成熟度 [source_005]。"},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"任务分解的静态 DAG 由应用层构建，路由层接收 DAG 并专注于逐节点模型选择，这一边界明确了平台职责 [source_006]。LangGraph 作为图状态机框架支持显式节点、边、持久状态与检查点，为 DeepAgents 提供底层编排能力 [source_002]。在此基础上，企业 Agent 平台需要同时满足复杂工作流状态恢复与高质量低成本推理路由两类需求。"},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"选型标准应直接对齐基准设计要求，包括固定任务 DAG、多候选模型、逐节点与逐任务评分、成本核算以及关键路径延迟测量 [source_007]。同时需满足静态 DAG 由应用层构造、路由器负责逐节点选择的功能边界 [source_006]，并兼顾 v0.1 评分规中对需求覆盖、证据准确、分析深度与可读性的综合要求 [source_008]。"},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents 作为 LangChain 编排框架构建于 LangGraph 之上，继承显式节点、边、持久状态与检查点能力 [source_001][source_002]，在多步工作流的状态恢复上具备优势，但原生不提供逐节点模型选择能力，需额外叠加路由层。DeepSeek Harness 被保留给外层验证环境，仅承担输出校验职能，不宜作为核心路由循环组件 [source_004]。类 RefractRouter 的逐节点路由方法直接优化质量-成本-延迟帕累托前沿 [source_005]，但仍处于研究方向，生产级耐久状态保证尚不充分。"},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"DeepAgents 深度绑定 LangChain 生态，引入编排开销且对简单路由场景过度工程化；其原生不支持逐节点路由，需自行实现并验证 [source_001][source_002]。DeepSeek Harness 若被误用于核心路由循环将偏离其设计定位，导致职责越界与基准失真 [source_004]。RefractRouter 类方案缺乏成熟生产部署与耐久状态保证，短期落地风险较高 [source_005]。"},{"heading":"Conclusion","paragraph":"推荐以 DeepAgents 承载复杂工作流编排与状态持久化，并在其之上叠加类 RefractRouter 的逐节点路由层以满足基准对质量、成本与关键路径延迟的综合测量 [source_001][source_005][source_007]。DeepSeek Harness 应严格保留于外层验证环境 [source_004]，而静态 DAG 构建由应用层负责 [source_006]，最终方案在分析深度与证据准确性上应满足 v0.1 评分规要求 [source_008]。"},{"heading":"References","paragraph":"[source_001] DeepAgents — DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph. [source_002] LangGraph — LangGraph is a graph state machine framework for complex workflows, supporting explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing. [source_004] DeepSeek Harness — DSH is reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop. {"title":"RefractRouter v0.1 Platform Selection: 2026 Enterprise LLM Agent Stack","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"RefractRouter v0.1 is a fixed-DAG per-node model router that needs a deterministic execution substrate, not an autonomous agent harness. The recommended stack is LangGraph as substrate plus DeepAgents in harness mode with planning disabled, with Pydantic AI held in reserve and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) reserved for the outer validation environment [source_001][source_002][source_003][source_004]. This split preserves the inner router's determinism while keeping outer evaluation pluggable, and the v0.1 benchmark reports quality, cost, and critical-path latency per node and per task [source_007]."},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"Current LLM routing research mostly selects one model for an entire request, leaving per-node Pareto gains largely unexplored [source_005]. RefractRouter closes that gap by receiving a fixed task DAG and selecting a model separately for each node, with dynamic re-splitting deferred until node-level routing is validated [source_006]. Because the application layer owns decomposition, the platform's job is to execute the DAG deterministically, expose per-node hooks, and record cost and latency."},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"The platform must provide fixed-DAG execution, typed or structured I/O for routing decisions, pluggable per-node model selection with cost and latency accounting, and a clear separation between inner routing and outer validation [source_006][source_007]. A reproducible routing benchmark additionally needs durable state, check-pointing, per-node and per-task scoring, and the ability to stay small enough to reproduce [source_007]. The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity, with prompts and rubric versions stored with each run [source_008]."},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph that adds planning, sub-agents, a filesystem abstraction, and human-in-the-loop controls; in v0.1 it serves as the fixed-DAG execution harness with autonomous planning and dynamic sub-agent generation disabled [source_001]. LangGraph is the lower-level graph state machine with explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing, and is the substrate RefractRouter actually relies on [source_002]. Pydantic AI offers typed tool definitions and structured model outputs, useful for the per-node decision interface but not required as a core dependency unless structured-output parsing becomes a bottleneck [source_003]. DeepSeek Harness (DSH) treats the agent loop itself as a plugin and is best confined to the outer validation environment, not the deterministic inner routing loop [source_004]."},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"Enabling DeepAgents' autonomous planning would re-introduce dynamic behavior the router is designed to avoid, so planning and sub-agent generation must remain off in v0.1 [source_001]. LangGraph alone satisfies the substrate requirements but requires more wiring than a higher-level harness, increasing build effort [source_002]. Adopting Pydantic AI as a core dependency before measured need enlarges the surface area without clear v0.1 benefit [source_003]. Letting DSH drive the inner loop would couple deterministic routing to a pluggable agent loop, undermining reproducibility [source_004]. Dynamic DAG re-splitting is also a risk if introduced before node-level routing is validated [source_006]."},{"heading":"Conclusion","paragraph":"For RefractRouter v0.1 the recommended stack is LangGraph as the execution substrate, DeepAgents in harness mode with planning and sub-agents disabled, Pydantic AI held in reserve, and DSH reserved for the outer validation environment [source_001][source_002][source_003][source_004]. The benchmark should report quality, cost, and critical-path latency, remain small enough to reproduce, and apply the v0.1 scoring rubric per node and per task with versioned prompts [source_007][source_008]. This configuration directly addresses the per-node routing research gap while keeping the inner loop deterministic and the outer evaluation pluggable [source_005]."},{"heading":"References","paragraph":"[source_001] DeepAgents. {"title":"2026 Enterprise LLM Agent Platform Selection for RefractRouter v0.1","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"RefractRouter v0.1 requires a fixed-DAG execution substrate with per-node model selection, so LangGraph is recommended as the core platform, with Pydantic AI added only when strict schemas are needed, DeepAgents used as a higher-level harness with autonomous features disabled, and DeepSeek Harness (DSH) confined to the outer validation environment [source_001][source_002][source_003][source_004]. A reproducible benchmark covering quality, cost, and critical-path latency validates per-node routing against the Pareto frontier before any dynamic re-splitting is introduced [source_005][source_006][source_007]."},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"Most LLM routing work selects one model per request, leaving the quality-cost-latency Pareto frontier underexplored at the node level, which motivates a per-node router [source_005]. To preserve that focus, static task decomposition stays in the application layer; the router receives a fixed DAG and selects models per node, while dynamic re-splitting is deferred until node-level routing is validated [source_006]."},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"The platform must support fixed-DAG execution, per-node model selection, typed structured outputs where required, and an outer validation environment that does not contaminate the core routing loop [source_001][source_003][source_004]. Operationally, a benchmark must use fixed task DAGs, multiple candidate models, per-node and per-task scoring, cost accounting, and critical-path latency, staying small enough to reproduce [source_007]. The v0.1 scoring rubric weights requirement coverage, evidence accuracy, analysis depth, structure and readability, and HTML validity, with prompts and rubric versions versioned with run records [source_008]."},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents is a LangChain harness built on LangGraph, providing planning, sub-agents, a filesystem abstraction, and human-in-the-loop controls, and because it is built on LangGraph it inherits explicit nodes, edges, durable state, and check-pointing [source_001][source_002]. Its autonomous planning and dynamic sub-agent generation should remain disabled to preserve the fixed-DAG contract, leaving it as a higher-level LangGraph execution harness [source_001]. LangGraph alone is the lower-level substrate for a fixed task DAG and is the best fit when minimal abstraction is preferred, though it lacks higher-level ergonomics [source_002]. Pydantic AI provides typed tool definitions and structured outputs and is valuable when schema strictness is required, but is not a core dependency for v0.1 unless structured-output parsing becomes a bottleneck [source_003]. DSH is an agent harness where the agent loop itself is a plugin and is reserved for the outer validation environment, not the core routing loop, since in-core use would conflate validation with execution [source_004]."},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"Enabling DeepAgents' autonomous planning or dynamic sub-agent generation would violate the fixed-DAG contract and should remain disabled, otherwise the router would inherit uncontrolled task reshaping [source_001]. Adopting Pydantic AI as a core dependency adds complexity without clear v0.1 benefit and risks premature abstraction unless structured-output parsing becomes a bottleneck [source_003]. Using DSH inside the core routing loop would conflate validation with execution, blurring the boundary that keeps the outer validation environment trustworthy [source_004]. {"title":"2026 年企业 LLM Agent 平台选型：RefractRouter v0.1 框架评估","sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraph":"本报告基于 RefractRouter v0.1 的研究目标评估四个候选框架/执行环境，重点比较其承载固定任务 DAG、按节点选择模型、结构化输出处理与受控外层验证的能力 [source_005]。结论是：核心路由回路采用 DeepAgents（构建于 LangGraph 之上）作为固定 DAG 执行框架，Pydantic AI 作为可选补充用于结构化输出热点路径，DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 仅用于外层验证环境 [source_001][source_003][source_004]。该组合在质量-成本-延迟的帕累托前沿上最契合按节点路由的研究方向 [source_005]。"},{"heading":"Background","paragraph":"RefractRouter 研究的核心问题是：现有 LLM 路由工作通常对整次请求选择一个模型，而本项目聚焦在任务 DAG 内部按节点选择模型，以改进质量、成本与关键路径延迟之间的权衡 [source_005]。在 v0.1 中，静态任务分解被划归应用层职责，路由器以 DAG 为输入并专注于按节点选型，动态再切分被推迟到节点级路由经验证之后 [source_006]。这一边界划定决定了执行框架必须能稳定承载固定 DAG，而不必承担自主规划或动态子代理生成的责任 [source_006]。"},{"heading":"Selection Criteria","paragraph":"依据源材料，v0.1 选型准则可归纳为四项：(1) 能否托管固定任务 DAG 并提供显式节点、边与持久化状态；(2) 是否支持按节点的模型选择与多候选模型评分；(3) 是否提供结构化输出与工具的类型化能力以应对热点瓶颈；(4) 是否具备可受控、可复现的外层验证环境 [source_005][source_006][source_007]。基准面被固定为：固定任务 DAG、多候选模型、按节点与按任务评分、成本核算与关键路径延迟 [source_007]。评分规则权重覆盖需求覆盖度、证据准确性、分析深度、结构与可读性，以及 HTML 有效性 [source_008]。"},{"heading":"Platform Comparison","paragraph":"DeepAgents 是构建于 LangGraph 之上的 LangChain 执行框架，提供规划、子代理、文件系统抽象与人机协同控制；v0.1 将其自主规划与动态子代理生成关闭，使其作为固定 DAG 执行引擎使用 [source_001]。LangGraph 是更底层的图状态机框架，支持显式节点、边、持久化状态与检查点，是 DeepAgents 的执行底座 [source_002]。Pydantic AI 提供类型化工具定义与结构化模型输出，但本身不是路由/DAG 框架，仅在结构化输出成为瓶颈时按需引入 [source_003]。DSH 将代理循环本身做成插件，但 v0.1 明确将其保留给外层验证环境，而非核心路由回路 [source_004]。基准与评分规则共同约束了评估面 [source_007][source_008]。"},{"heading":"Risks","paragraph":"主要风险包括：(1) DeepAgents 高于 LangGraph 抽象层，若未来需要更细粒度控制可能需回归底层，增加工程成本 [source_001][source_002]；(2) 关闭自主规划与动态子代理可能限制 v0.1 后续对动态重切分的探索，需要在节点级路由验证后再评估 [source_001][source_006]；(3) Pydantic AI 作为可选依赖存在集成复杂度与版本漂移风险 [source_003]；(4) DSH 仅用于外层验证，若误用进核心回路将破坏确定性与可复现性 [source_004]；(5) 评分提示词与规则版本必须与运行记录一同版本化，否则基准可比性受损 [source_008]。"},{"heading":"Conclusion","paragraph":"综合权衡，v0.1 推荐采用 DeepAgents（构建于 LangGraph 之上）作为固定 DAG 执行框架，Pydantic AI 作为可选补充，DSH 保留给外层验证环境 [source_001][source_002][source_003][source_004]。该组合直接对应按节点路由研究问题与应用层分解边界，并由基准与评分规则提供可比、可复现的评估面 [source_005][source_006][source_007][source_008]。后续在节点级路由得到验证后，可重新评估动态再切分与更高层规划能力。"},{"heading":"References","paragraph":"[source_001] DeepAgents；[source_002] LangGraph；[source_003] Pydantic AI；[source_004] DeepSeek Harness；[source_005] LLM routing research gap；[source_006] Task decomposition boundary；[source_007] Benchmark design；[source_008] Scoring rubric。各条目的完整主张与内容哈希见下方
